correctness.rationale: The seven-element independence argument forces A^3=0 for three-dimensional associative zero-square algebras. The annihilator is exactly one-dimensional for any nonzero product, so the alternating bilinear product is a scalar multiple of det(w,-,-)w. This is equivalent, in both directions and over every characteristic-two field, to a symmetric rank-one matrix. Standard symmetric determinantal/Veronese coordinate-ring facts give the reduced prime ideal, dimension, degree 4, Hilbert series and smooth locus. The independent exhaustive program tests all 512 products over F2 and 262144 over F4, confirming 8 and 64 associative products, no disagreements.
